title: SQLite Database
concept: SQLite bindings for XIOM — embedded SQL database with zero configuration, full SQL support, and transactional safety.
why: SQLite is the most deployed database in the world — it's in every phone, browser, and embedded device. Perfect for local storage and single-process apps.
tips: Use parameterized queries (?) always — never concatenate user input into SQL strings
Transactions protect data integrity — group related writes in a transaction
SQLite is single-writer — use WAL mode for better concurrent read performance
Vacuum periodically to reclaim space after deletions
common_mistakes: SQL injection via string concatenation — ALWAYS use parameterized queries
Forgetting to handle SQLITE_BUSY — the database is locked by another connection
Using SQLite for high-concurrency write workloads — consider PostgreSQL for that
